scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is conditional on a compact invariant probability measure supported in \(z>0\) for the autonomous integer-order QPP flow. It does not establish existence of periodic or chaotic invariant sets, does not apply to the delayed or fractional equations, and uses no finite-time numerical data as proof. The earliest verified public-source evidence is the author-uploaded full text dated 2020-08-19; the publisher records early access on 2020-09-07.
title: Exact pressure–activity law for recurrent QPP dynamics
